Project Tiger was launched on April 1, 1973, by the Union
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change.

and as of March 2024, it has been expanded to 55 reserves.
The National Tiger Conservation Authority (NTCA) was
established in 2005 to streamline the management of Project
Tiger. Under the project tiger, the first tiger census was
conducted in 1972. As per the latest tiger census, Madhya
Pradesh has the highest tiger population in India.

singing, and throwing colours at each other.
